details: Restored skippable premium typewriter splash and progressive heading/card text in FARUKH REVISION PRO and MORE SUSHI mobile tabs, with a shared presentation-only motion helper. The authenticated TTK workspace gets the same lightweight typewriter text on headings. Respects reduced-motion preferences. No delay to data loading, changes to stock counts, Supabase, revision, TTK/PDF, login, or business logic. No new visual theme overlaid; existing pearl-rose CSS and inline revision style edited in place. Revision entry links bust WebView cache. Actual Xiaomi device and cloud workflows require manual verification.
